# Offline browser dependencies

- Three.js 0.170.0: `three.module.js` and `OrbitControls.js`, MIT, see `THREE-LICENSE`.
  Sources: https://www.npmjs.com/package/three/v/0.170.0
- Lucide 0.468.0: `lucide.min.js`, ISC, see `LUCIDE-LICENSE`.
  Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/lucide/v/0.468.0

These files are vendored so opening the viewer requires no CDN access or Node.js.
